data.description: Downtown Office Incentive agreement for AndHealth's headquarters establishment and expansion at 2 Miranova Place.
data.scope: Approximately $1.115 million planned project cost; 65 new positions with about $6.155 million estimated annual payroll; retention of 21 positions with about $1.9 million payroll.

notes: The reviewed ordinance authorizes the agreement but does not state a fixed total payout ceiling.

provenance.method: Primary-source recursive OSINT with bounded inference

summary: Columbus authorized a Downtown Office Incentive agreement supporting AndHealth's headquarters expansion and 65 planned new jobs.
title: AndHealth Columbus Downtown Office Incentive agreement
